audience: small hotels and guesthouses that run their front desk, rates and bookings in Avirato

useCases.title: Check tomorrow's arrivals and departures
useCases.text: List the reservations between two dates to see who checks in and who checks out. Open a reservation to read the guest, the room and the outstanding amount.

useCases.title: Find a room and quote the price of a stay
useCases.text: Check availability for the dates. Then get the price of the stay for a room type, a rate and the number of guests, and compare the rates the hotel offers.

useCases.title: Review the price calendar and discounts
useCases.text: Read the price of each day for a period and the discounts that apply to room types and rates. Check the minimum-stay rules before you confirm a quote.

useCases.title: Trace a booking from a sales channel
useCases.text: List the booking channels, then get a reservation by the channel's booking id. Read the other rooms of a group booking in the same view.

useCases.title: Record a cash payment on a booking
useCases.text: Read the booking to check the outstanding amount. The assistant confirms the booking id and the amount with you, then records the cash payment. Card payments are not supported.
